{{Quote|Doesn't sound to me like the Captain has a very high opinion of our troopers.''"<br />"''Can you blame him?''"<br />"''Under the circumstances, I suppose not.|Wyan and Mosh Barris|<ref name="ME">{{JournalCite|7|Mist Encounter}}</ref>}}
'''Wyan''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]].

Competent and efficient, he served under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Mosh Barris/Legends|Mosh Barris]] on the [[Strikefast/Legends|''Strikefast'']]. During this mission in which [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] first made contact with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Barris's right-hand man, he put his experience with hostile natives into securing the Empire's base camp from a mysterious series of attacks, which turned out to be engineered by Mitth'raw'nuruodo.
